description: Exact parameter sweeps used for the two comparison methods. Both baselines were swept exhaustively over the full grid on every log and every seed.

selection_protocol.summary: Per-log, per-seed best-parameter selection for the baselines; a single global configuration for DupliMend.
detail: For each (log, seed) pair the full grid below was evaluated and the best-scoring parameter combination was retained for that pair.

This is deliberately favourable to the baselines: they effectively receive per-log oracle tuning, whereas DupliMend is evaluated with one fixed global configuration (config/paper_configs/duplimend_global.json) across all logs.
Report both the swept results and the selected-best results when comparing; the raw sweep is the file with all parameter columns, the selected subset is the BEST_PARAMS_ONLY file.

Label-Refinement.reference: Lu et al., label refinement via variant/unfolding thresholds

PM-Label-Splitting.reference: PM label-splitting baseline over context-window distance

Unrefined.reference: The input log with no refinement applied; the lower-bound control condition.
Unrefined.note: No parameters. One row per (log, seed).

simulation_fallback.detail: python-label-refinement-baselines/main.py previously substituted simulated metrics when a real run failed. It now aborts instead. Simulated output requires the explicit --allow-simulation-fallback flag (or PM_ALLOW_SIM_FALLBACK=1), and no published result was produced with that flag set.
